Quiz: Which of the following code results in the following output?

![](data:image/png;base64,)

The style is:

```css
.styled-text {
    color: red;
    font-size: 24px;
    font-style: italic;
}
```

Tap an option below to answer:

```html
<h1>Tropical Mangoes</h1>
<p class="styled-text">Sweet and juicy flesh.</p>
<h3>Beautiful Mangoes</h3>
<p>Vibrant yellow-orange color.</p>
<p class="styled-text">Rich in vitamins.<p>
```

##### Incorrect, give it another shot!

The styled-text class is applied exactly to the elements that don't have any style. While the elements that are styled don't have the styled-text class.

The styled-text class is applied exactly to the elements that don't have any style. While the elements that are styled don't have the styled-text class.

##### Incorrect, give it another shot!

The styled-text class is only applied to the <p> elements. However, in the above image, the headings are also styled.

The styled-text class is only applied to the <p> elements. However, in the above image, the headings are also styled.
